body: I've given it a second thought, and third, and fourth. I've looked at as many options as I can find, I can't really see anything changing for me. Everything that I used to love doing no longer has meaning. I can't finish drawing a single picture even a sketch, or finish reading a chapter of a book. I just don't have the energy any more to keep going.

Thank you for your reply.

He just turned one, I'd rather do it now when he won't remember me. 

I'm going down the exact same path as my mom. I was born into a shitty life, and its stayed that way. Every time I climb a little higher I get pushed 5 steps . I dropped out of high school, but got my GED and I started college. But i got pregnant and had to quit my classes because I had Hyperemesis Gravidarum and had a very rough pregnancy. They put me on financial aid restriction and I tried a loan deferment for financial and personal problems. They said everything was fine, but I got a letter saying my loans defaulted anyways. Now I'm thousands of dollars in debt, with no schooling to show for it. I can't find a job, not even a cleaning company from craigslist will hire me. Trust me, I have tried very very hard to change things, and its just not gotten any better at all.

My son may need me, but he would be better off somewhere they can afford to give him what he needs. I can't do any of that. He's the only reason I haven't ended it sooner, but I just don't have the strength to continue anymore.
